wording_rules: The open page affects the suggested-question chips (fixed templates using the page title). It is NOT sent into the answer retrieval/chat path.
Memory in narration is only: 'The model also receives recent conversation context.'
Source cards: 'the textbook passages the retrieval step surfaced and supplied as context for the answer.' Never repeat the UI label 'Top sources used' as proof of use.
Cards are not a sentence-by-sentence citation audit. Grounding does not guarantee correctness.

No: open-chapter-only, open page drives retrieval, cards prove reliance, per-sentence citation, guaranteed correctness, cannot hallucinate, every answer has sources, trained on the textbook, 'best' passages, model name, 'per user' memory.

beats.narration_text: When you ask a real question, the system searches the textbook for related passages. Those passages are handed to the model as context. The model also receives its tutor instructions and recent conversation context. It writes the answer from all of that, and the same passages are shown to you, so you can check them.

shot.visual_intent: Six plain-language steps light one by one with the narration: Your question -> Search the textbook -> Relevant passages -> Given to the model as context -> Answer -> You inspect the passages. The 'context' step shows three small labels: passages, tutor instructions, recent conversation. No implementation terms on screen.

beats.narration_text: A follow-up can make sense because the model also receives recent conversation context. But the textbook search runs again on the new question, and here the new cards drift off topic. beats.narration_text: My verdict. The answer is generated with textbook passages in its context, and those passages are exposed so you can inspect them. That makes it more connected to the textbook and easier to verify. It doesn't make the answer automatically correct. The cards are a place to check the answer, not proof that every sentence came from a particular card.

The site says it too: AI can make mistakes. Please verify important information.
More connected. Easier to verify. Still yours to check.
